title: LS:MP operator settings (resources.json)
description: Next to server.cfg: what the server's operator decides about each resource. Read once, at server start. https://lsmp.gg/resources/api#operator-settings

resources.description: Keyed by resource name; a marketplace mod is keyed mod.<name>.

enabled.description: false: not packed, not started, not sent to players.

sandbox.description: false trusts the resource: full machine access and lsmp.mysql. Only for code you trust.

clientMount.description: auto: mounted as players join; manual: downloaded, mounted by lsmp.mountResource; never: not sent to players.

after.description: Resources to start before this one, on top of its own dependencies.
